cf-9001.drafting_notes: Guide example E1. The guide's candidate, the trapezoidal rule as such, has no work dated before the claim with a cacheable text: OpenAlex has no abstract for Yeh and Kwan 1978 (W2009136130), Chiou 1978 (W2066806870), Purves 1992 (W2042925852) or Bailer 1988 (W2029789274); Matthews et al. 1990 BMJ (PMC1662068) and four other pre-1994 PMC papers tried have no full-text XML in Europe PMC, and the J Gen Physiol full texts that do (PMC2215046, PMC2215108, PMC2215434) only name the rule; the arXiv API returns no paper on the rule before 1994; the Semantic Scholar client has no key and the OpenAlex search budget of the day was spent, so only identifiers known in advance could be looked up. c1 is Bailer and Piegorsch 1990, Biometrics (W2316008801), whose OpenAlex abstract describes quadrature for areas under concentration-time curves and names the trapezoidal rule as the simplest Newton-Cotes procedure. Le Floch et al. 1990, Diabetes Care (W2095455974), also names the rule for glucose AUC but is same-field, so it was not used. Exposure: Monaco and Anderson, 'Tai's formula is the trapezoidal rule', Diabetes Care 17(10):1224-1225 (W2125573108). Tai's OpenAlex record has no reference list, so the attribution hint is unknown.
